svg.title: Standardized sample mean of an exponential sample at three sample sizes
svg.desc: Three stacked panels on a shared standardized axis. The exact density of the standardized sample mean is drawn against a standard normal curve; the right skew that is obvious at n = 5 fades but has not vanished at n = 200.
svg.text: The mean of an exponential sample, standardized, against the normal limit
Population: exponential, skewness 2. The horizontal axis is (xbar minus mu) divided by sigma over
root n. The shaded piece is the part above 1.645, where the normal curve places 0.050 of its
